pokedexEntries.go: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokedexEntries.si: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

pokedexEntries.cr: If the impact site of a meteorite is found, this POKéMON is certain to be within the immediate area.

pokedexEntries.rs: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these POKéMON quench their thirst with the morning dew.

pokedexEntries.fr: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

pokedexEntries.lg: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokedexEntries.em: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.

pokedexEntries.di: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

pokedexEntries.prl: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

pokedexEntries.pt: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.

pokedexEntries.hg: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokedexEntries.ss: When numerous meteors illuminate the night sky, sightings of CLEFFA strangely increase.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is often seen when shooting stars fill the night skies. It’s said to arrive riding on a shooting star.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

pokedexEntries.x: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokedexEntries.y: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

pokedexEntries.oras: On nights with many shooting stars, Cleffa can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance through the night and stop only at the break of day, when these Pokémon quench their thirst with the morning dew.

pokedexEntries.su: On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.

pokedexEntries.mo: Because of its silhouette, it’s believed to be a star reborn. For some reason, it loves Minior.

pokedexEntries.us: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

pokedexEntries.um: Said to have ridden here on a shooting star, Cleffa seem to appear in places where meteorites have struck in the past.

pokedexEntries.sw: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.

pokedexEntries.sh: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

pokedexEntries.bd: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

pokedexEntries.shp: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

pokedexEntries.la: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.
